audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A soft male voice speaks playfully to a child; the tone is warm and high in arousal. No BGM. Ambient room tone is quiet. (2) Upbeat synth-pop BGM with a steady electronic beat enters. The male voice shifts to a faster, narrative style. Faint supermarket chatter and refrigerator hum in the background. (3) A series of metallic and plastic rustling sounds as items are handled in a basket. The BGM remains consistent and energetic. (4) In the kitchen, the sound of a plastic vegetable bag being opened (high-frequency rustle). The man's voice is focused and descriptive. (5) Ceramic clinks and the sound of vegetables being moved into a bowl. BGM continues at a moderate volume. (6) A sharp 'click' of the stove igniting followed by the consistent hiss and crackle of oil frying in a pan. Vocal delivery is rapid. (7) Liquid pouring into a hot pan creates a brief 'sizzle' sound. The BGM beat matches the rhythmic stir-frying sounds. (8) Sound of a soda can opening (fizz) and liquid pouring over ice cubes (tinkling sounds). The man makes a soft 'crunching' sound while eating. (9) Transition to exercise: heavy rhythmic breathing and vocalized exertion. A loud 'thud' occurs as a kettlebell is placed on the wooden floor. (10) A child's high-pitched voice counts 'one, two, three' clearly and energetically. The male voice responds with short, strained words of effort. (11) Repeated 'thud' sounds of small feet jumping on a floor. Laughter and playful chatter between the male and child voices close out the segment over the fading BGM.
